scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind creating a classwork folder.
Folder: organises related digital files. File name: helps identify a saved item.
Copy: makes a second version of an item. Move: changes where an item is stored. Rename: changes the label without changing the file content.
With an adult supervising, practise folder and file name using a computer if one is available. Without a computer, draw the screen and explain each step to a partner.
